title: The Rook Ladder
setup: Two rooks against Black's bare king on e7, and the rook on a6 already fences off the whole sixth rank.
hint: One rook holds a rank while the other checks on the next one up.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is the rook ladder. The rook on a6 holds the sixth rank, so {{Rb7+}} checks along the seventh and leaves the king only the back rank: {{Kd8}}, {{Ke8}} or {{Kf8}}.

Wherever it goes, {{Ra8#}} climbs to the last rank. The rook on b7 keeps the whole seventh, and the king has nowhere left. Cut, check, cut, check: two rooks need no help from anything else.
